### Material name
(E.g. "Q355 steel", "C30 concrete", "bamboo")

### Target unit system
- [ ] Metric (materials.json)
- [ ] Imperial (materials_us.json)

### Suggested parameters
| Parameter | Suggested value | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| Young's modulus E | | GPa |
| Yield / compressive strength | | MPa |
| Density | | kg/m³ |
| Poisson's ratio ν | | |
| Linear thermal expansion coefficient α | | /°C |
| Max long-term service temperature | | °C |
| Strength type | yield / compression / tension | |

### Data source
(Standard number, literature, material handbook, etc., so the values can be verified. E.g. "GB/T 1591-2018", "AISC 360-16")

### Usage scenarios
(Which everyday scenarios this material is commonly used in, to help design templates later)
